# 1 Enoch Chapter 88 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams — Animal Apocalypse

---

**1** And one of those four white ones came to me and took me by my hand and raised me up and set me down on the side of those sheep, far from them; and he gave me a sword.

**2** And I saw the abyss opened in the midst of the earth, full of fire, and they brought those blind sheep, and they were all judged and found guilty and cast into this fiery abyss, and they burned.

**3** Now that abyss was to the right of that house.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Ge'ez text. Chapter 88 is the shortest chapter in the Animal Apocalypse. It records the final judgment of the rebellious Watchers (symbolized as 'blind sheep' here — a shift from stars to sheep symbolism, possibly indicating Watchers who had taken animal form) and their consignment to the fiery abyss. Enoch receives a sword — his role shifts from witness to participant-judge.*
